techniques.name: Random search
techniques.goal: Find useful configurations without assuming smooth structure
techniques.mechanism: Sample independent configurations from defined parameter distributions and evaluate them against objective/constraints.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Baseline optimizer: more complex methods must beat it on Agent OS task suites.
avoid_when: Every evaluation is very expensive and strong prior exists
risks: Wastes trials in obviously poor regions

techniques.name: Grid search
techniques.goal: Systematically characterize a very small discrete parameter space
techniques.mechanism: Evaluate Cartesian product of candidate values.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful for reasoning-effort/verbosity/top-k sweeps with tiny spaces.

techniques.name: Bayesian optimization
techniques.goal: Choose informative configurations for expensive noisy objectives
techniques.mechanism: Fit probabilistic surrogate to observed performance and use acquisition function to balance exploration/exploitation.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Good candidate for thresholds/weights after robust eval metric exists.
techniques.cost_profile: fewer expensive trials, more optimizer logic

techniques.name: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization
techniques.goal: Use cheap approximate evaluations to screen candidates before full expensive evaluation
techniques.mechanism: Model fidelity level alongside configuration and allocate expensive high-fidelity trials selectively.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use smoke suite → medium suite → protected full suite.
use_when: Can use subset/smaller model/short run as proxy
avoid_when: Cheap proxy poorly predicts full result

techniques.name: Successive halving
techniques.goal: Stop weak candidates early and allocate more budget to promising ones
techniques.mechanism: Evaluate many configurations with small resource; repeatedly keep top fraction and increase resource.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Candidate prompt/tool/model tournament with staged eval suites.
use_when: Prompt/model candidates where early subset predicts full suite
avoid_when: Learning curves/nonstationary candidates where early result misleads

techniques.name: Hyperband
techniques.goal: Hedge uncertainty about how aggressively to early-stop candidate configurations
techniques.mechanism: Run multiple successive-halving brackets with different initial candidate counts/resources.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Potential prompt/tool optimizer scheduler, not needed until catalog-driven experiments scale.
use_when: Large candidate search with tunable eval budget

techniques.name: Population Based Training / exploit-explore schedules
techniques.goal: Adapt hyperparameters over a run rather than choosing one static setting
techniques.mechanism: Train population in parallel; periodically copy stronger state to weak workers and mutate hyperparameters.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Conceptually useful for self-improving search but too heavy for application defaults.
use_when: Long adaptive optimization where state can be cloned

techniques.name: Thompson sampling
techniques.goal: Balance learning and exploitation in repeated uncertain decisions
techniques.mechanism: Maintain posterior belief for each action's reward; sample from posteriors and choose action with highest sampled value.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Only within policy-safe action set; no exploration of unsafe actions.

techniques.name: Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) bandit
techniques.goal: Explore uncertain options optimistically while exploiting high performers
techniques.mechanism: Choose action maximizing estimated reward plus uncertainty bonus.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful conceptual baseline against Thompson sampling.
avoid_when: Context strongly changes outcomes unless contextual variant used

techniques.name: Contextual bandits / LinUCB
techniques.goal: Learn which action works best conditional on task/user context
techniques.mechanism: Estimate action payoff from context features while adding uncertainty/exploration bonus.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Long-term candidate for low-risk proactivity after deterministic policy and offline replay exist.

techniques.name: Safe constrained bandits
techniques.goal: Optimize among choices while respecting hard risk/cost constraints
techniques.mechanism: Apply bandit only after deterministic eligibility filter; constrain exploration to options satisfying safety/privacy/budget bounds.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Authorization policy defines feasible action set before learner sees it.
use_when: Any future online learning in Agent OS

techniques.name: Offline policy evaluation before online learning
techniques.goal: Estimate candidate routing/proactivity policy from logged historical interactions before exposing users
techniques.mechanism: Replay logged contexts/actions/rewards using direct modeling and, when logging propensities support it, counterfactual estimators.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer shadow replay first; never deploy bandit because simulator likes it.
avoid_when: Logs lack action propensities/coverage or reward is badly confounded

techniques.name: A/B randomized controlled experiment
techniques.goal: Estimate causal effect of one system change
techniques.mechanism: Randomly assign eligible comparable tasks/users/runs to control or treatment and compare predefined metrics.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use task-stratified experiments where ordinary user-randomization is not meaningful.
use_when: Prompt/UI/proactivity/routing changes with enough repeated traffic

techniques.name: A/A test
techniques.goal: Validate instrumentation/randomization and false-positive behavior before trusting A/B system
techniques.mechanism: Run identical treatment/control configurations and inspect sample ratio, metric differences and alert rates.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Required before using live proactivity/routing experiments for causal claims.

techniques.name: CUPED variance reduction
techniques.goal: Detect smaller treatment effects with same sample size using pre-experiment correlated data
techniques.mechanism: Regress outcome on pre-period covariates and compare variance-reduced adjusted metrics.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Could help future high-volume proactivity experiments; not useful for tiny offline benchmark sets.
use_when: Repeated user/task units with stable pre-period behavior

techniques.name: Factorial experiment design
techniques.goal: Estimate main effects and interactions among several knobs more efficiently than one-factor-at-a-time
techniques.mechanism: Vary multiple factors systematically across combinations and analyze effects/interactions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Better than changing several knobs in one unstructured 'improved prompt'.
avoid_when: Too many factors/levels for available eval budget
techniques.cost_profile: more efficient than exhaustive naive testing

techniques.name: Fractional factorial screening
techniques.goal: Identify high-impact knobs from many candidates using fewer combinations
techniques.mechanism: Evaluate carefully chosen fraction of full factorial under assumptions about negligible higher-order interactions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful for hundreds of MIC knobs after grouping by subsystem.

techniques.name: Response surface optimization
techniques.goal: Refine continuous settings near a promising region
techniques.mechanism: Fit local response model from designed experiments and search for optimum/tradeoff region.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Candidate for retrieval thresholds and alert scoring, with holdout confirmation.

techniques.name: Shewhart control chart
techniques.goal: Detect large unexpected shifts away from a stable baseline
techniques.mechanism: Plot quality metric with empirically/statistically derived center/control limits and investigate special-cause violations.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Monitor by task/model/version rather than one global quality stream.

techniques.name: CUSUM drift detection
techniques.goal: Detect persistent small shifts sooner than ordinary point thresholds
techniques.mechanism: Accumulate signed deviations from target and signal when cumulative statistic crosses threshold.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Useful research-radar trigger for silent provider/model regressions.

techniques.name: EWMA drift detection
techniques.goal: Detect gradual small shifts while smoothing noisy observations
techniques.mechanism: Maintain exponentially weighted mean emphasizing recent data and compare to control limits.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Store baseline/version boundaries so model upgrades don't appear as unexplained drift.
avoid_when: Sparse events with no stable sampling cadence

techniques.name: Pareto analysis of failure causes
techniques.goal: Focus improvement effort on the few failure classes causing most harm
techniques.mechanism: Aggregate classified defects by frequency×impact, sort descending and target dominant contributors first.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Run both frequency Pareto and impact-weighted Pareto.
avoid_when: Rare catastrophic failures require separate treatment

techniques.name: Statistical drift alarm followed by diagnosis, not automatic mutation
techniques.goal: Separate 'something changed' from 'we know how to fix it'
techniques.mechanism: Monitoring raises observation; diagnosis/research identifies cause; experiments test candidate changes before rollout.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Core safety rule: anomaly detector creates evidence, never self-authorizes code/prompt changes.

techniques.name: Exploration budget
techniques.goal: Bound how much user utility/cost may be sacrificed to learn better policies
techniques.mechanism: Allocate explicit fraction/absolute budget for safe challenger traffic; suspend exploration when reliability budget is low.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Tie exploration to error/reliability budget and user-facing risk.
risks: Budget choice itself may be arbitrary

techniques.name: Change-freeze on out-of-control quality
techniques.goal: Stop stacking behavior changes when the system is already unstable
techniques.mechanism: If SLO/error budget or control-chart signal indicates significant degradation, pause nonessential adaptive changes until baseline is restored/understood.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Security fixes remain exempt; experimentation can continue in isolated offline environments.
avoid_when: Initial prototyping before stable baseline exists
risks: Can slow feature progress due noisy alert
techniques.cost_profile: opportunity cost but reduces compounding failure
